content.comment_body: Hello. If the connection between the operator interface and the [product_name] device fails, does the device keep the last timer value received from the interface?

Yes, the [product_name] retains the last value it received. However, if a power outage occurs, that value is lost. To avoid this, you can use Parameter VM Mapping to store the timer value directly into the device's flash memory, ensuring it persists even after power is restored.
Yes, my issue is resolved. Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: The thread discusses timer value retention on [product_name] devices when communication with the operator interface is interrupted. Users clarify that the device keeps the last timer value unless there is a power failure, in which case the value is lost. It is recommended to use Parameter VM Mapping so timer values are saved to flash memory for persistence across reboots.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect timer settings on the [product_name] to remain intact, even if the connection to the operator interface is lost or the device loses power.
